record.label: Exposure-trained two-auxiliary-state successor
record.summary: The single preregistered 20-epoch successor adds two independently Phi*W-transported per-unit auxiliary channels to the frozen primary recurrence. Its finite autonomous development MSE is 3.451830389554841e-8 versus parent 3.4709697955756664e-8, only a 0.5514% improvement; it fails the assigned <3.123872816e-8 primary gate and the <1e-8 stretch gate. Same-checkpoint teacher-forced MSE is 1.1469792562224471e-8. Observer-selection and observer_fit ranks >=200 were not opened.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for this exact two-auxiliary-channel exposure schedule because it failed both preregistered accuracy gates; materially different full-population or higher-capacity state providers remain open.
